children.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory Under Coarse-Graining

detail.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory Under Coarse-Graining
detail.summary: This revision synthesizes causal-state reconstruction with thermodynamic constraints on physical information storage. We find that physical causal memory requires not just statistical persistence, but a demonstrated link between the internal state and future observable dynamics, fundamentally limited by the information accessibility imposed by coarse-graining.
detail.reason: Incorporating recent peer-collected evidence to refine the mapping between causal state reconstruction and thermodynamic bounds.
